definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase
definitions.declared_role: Base class for all policy QA agents.
notes: CLS-001/FUN-005: This class owns AutoGen routing identity, bounded ListMemory, metrics and lifecycle state; the RoutedAgent/ABC/Generic inheritance serves actual pack implementations.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.__init__
notes: CLS-002/FUN-003: Initializes the RoutedAgent description plus per-instance memory, queue, metrics and logging; memory_size has a positive boundary check and unknown options are no longer silently accepted via unused **kwargs.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.process_request
definitions.declared_role: Process a request. Must be implemented by subclasses.
notes: FUN-005: Abstract asynchronous pack entry point is consumed by concrete agents and AutoGen callbacks, so an empty abstract body is required protocol rather than a removable wrapper.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.handle_message
notes: FUN-001/FUN-005: Filters directed messages, stores memory, routes a capability and emits an explicit ERROR AgentMessage on ordinary failure; cancellation is not swallowed.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase._route_message
notes: FUN-003/FUN-005: The message-type-to-handler lookup represents real optional capabilities across pack subclasses; missing handlers legitimately return None and are logged.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase._store_in_memory
notes: RES-001: Owns a ListMemory append and bounds the same instance's retained content to memory_size; asynchronous memory API is preserved.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase._update_metrics
notes: FUN-001: Updates this agent's processed-message count and running average from one measured duration; the helper has a coherent shared-state responsibility.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.send_policy_message
definitions.declared_role: Send a message to another agent.
notes: FUN-005: Builds the policy AgentMessage contract, preserves correlation identity and publishes through the actual AutoGen default topic.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.get_memory_context
notes: FUN-001: Returns recent textual memory as a string; negative limits fail and zero explicitly means no history rather than Python's [-0:] full slice.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.get_metrics
notes: FUN-001: Adds memory/queue/running information to the agent metrics; it is a useful observation boundary rather than a forwarding accessor.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.start
notes: FUN-005: Retained lifecycle hook changes the running state and is overridden by the session manager to start its owned cleanup task.

definitions.name: PolicyAgentBase.stop
notes: FUN-005: Retained lifecycle hook clears the running state and is called by task-owning subclasses after cleanup.

definitions.name: StatefulAgent
definitions.declared_role: Base class for agents that maintain state.
notes: CLS-001: Shared persistent_state and state_version are the explicit state boundary for vector, graph and answer packs; the class is not a static helper holder.

definitions.name: StatefulAgent.__init__
notes: CLS-002: Initializes the policy base before creating per-agent state and a version counter; kwargs are forwarded to the actual base constructor.

definitions.name: StatefulAgent.update_state
notes: FUN-001: Applies one state update and advances its version; the asynchronous public agent-state operation is retained.

definitions.name: StatefulAgent.persist_state
notes: ERR-001: Unsupported persistence raises NotImplementedError visibly instead of pretending that in-memory state was saved.

definitions.name: StatefulAgent.restore_state
notes: ERR-001: Unsupported restoration raises NotImplementedError visibly instead of returning fabricated persistent state.

definitions.name: ReactiveAgent
definitions.declared_role: Base class for reactive agents that respond to events.
notes: CLS-001/FUN-005: Owns registered event callbacks and trigger rules used by PolicyAnalyzerAgent; the class carries real shared state.

definitions.name: ReactiveAgent.__init__
notes: CLS-002: Creates independent event-handler and trigger collections after base initialization, avoiding shared mutable class defaults.

definitions.name: ReactiveAgent.register_event_handler
notes: FUN-005: Stores callbacks by the actual event key; short registration methods are required by the reactive agent's protocol.

definitions.name: ReactiveAgent.add_trigger
definitions.declared_role: Add a trigger condition and action.
notes: FUN-001: Records a condition/action pair in the same owning agent; callback values remain awaitable rather than being probed dynamically.

definitions.name: ReactiveAgent.check_triggers
definitions.declared_role: Check if any triggers are activated by the event.
notes: FUN-005: Evaluates registered trigger conditions and awaits their actions sequentially, preserving action failure/cancellation visibility.

definitions.name: ReactiveAgent._evaluate_condition
notes: FUN-001: Implements the documented equality-match trigger condition against an event mapping; no speculative rule-engine layer is added.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent
definitions.declared_role: Base class for proactive agents that initiate actions.
notes: CLS-001/ASY-006: Owns goals, plans and scheduled task handles; retaining this base preserves the tested scheduling/stop protocol.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.__init__
notes: CLS-002/ASY-006: Initializes independent goal/plan lists and an owned task set after policy-base initialization.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.add_goal
definitions.declared_role: Add a goal for the agent to pursue.
notes: FUN-001: Adds a concrete goal to the agent-owned goal list and records it; this is shared mutable state rather than a stateless wrapper.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.create_plan
definitions.declared_role: Create a plan to achieve a goal.
notes: ERR-001: Explicit extension operation raises NotImplementedError; no fake plan or silent successful result is manufactured.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.execute_plan
notes: ERR-001: Explicit extension operation raises NotImplementedError; execution is not reported successful without an implementation.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.start_task_scheduler
definitions.declared_role: Mark this agent ready to own scheduled work.
notes: FUN-005: Existing public readiness hook delegates to the lifecycle start operation; retained to preserve the scheduler-facing lifecycle interface.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.schedule_task
definitions.declared_role: Schedule work whose completion and cancellation belong to this agent.
notes: ASY-006: Owns the created task, delayed coroutine start and completion callback; the coroutine is closed if cancellation occurs before execution.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.schedule_task.run
notes: ASY-005/ASY-006: Nested task coroutine implements the actual delay boundary and closes a never-started coroutine in finally; it cannot be replaced with an unowned create_task.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.schedule_task.completed
notes: FUN-005/ASY-006: Task callback removes the exact task handle, closes pre-start work and retrieves/logs task exceptions so failures are observed.

definitions.name: ProactiveAgent.stop
notes: ASY-005/ASY-009: Cancels owned tasks, drains them inside a finite shield and delegates to the base lifecycle stop; cancellation and cleanup remain explicit.

changes: Removed silently ignored **kwargs from PolicyAgentBase.__init__; real subclass/base options keep explicit signatures and unknown options now fail visibly.

definitions.name: AgentFactory

definitions.name: AgentFactory.__init__

definitions.name: AgentFactory._load_llm_config

definitions.name: AgentFactory.register_agent

definitions.name: AgentFactory.get_agent

definitions.name: AgentFactory.create_all_agents
definitions.declared_role: Create all necessary agents for the policy QA system.

definitions.name: AgentFactory.aclose
definitions.declared_role: Close successfully constructed resources, including after a partial build.

definitions.name: AgentFactory.create_agent_group

definitions.name: AgentFactory.process_query
definitions.declared_role: Process a user query through the agent pipeline.
notes: FUN-005: Public factory facade checks that the coordinator exists and delegates to its established asynchronous workflow contract.

definitions.name: EmbeddingManager.__init__

definitions.name: EmbeddingManager._load_index

definitions.name: EmbeddingManager.encode_documents

definitions.name: EmbeddingManager.search

definitions.name: EmbeddingManager._save_index

definitions.name: EmbeddingManager.rebuild_index

definitions.name: SessionManager
definitions.declared_role: 会话管理器：支持内存 + DB 双存储。
notes: CLS-001/RES-001: Owns session cache, SSE queues, a reentrant lock and a cleanup task; optional history_store is the supported memory-only versus persistent mode.

definitions.name: SessionManager.__init__
notes: CLS-002: Stores configured timeouts/history backend and initializes independent cache/queue/task ownership; RLock permits intentional nested session operations.

definitions.name: SessionManager.create_session

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_session

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_or_create_session
notes: FUN-001: Resolves cache, persisted record or creation in one locked flow, preserving optional user and connection binding behavior.

definitions.name: SessionManager.add_message
notes: FUN-001: Computes title/order, performs configured persistence before appending cache state and deep-copies payload data to prevent caller mutation.

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_messages

definitions.name: SessionManager.update_context
notes: FUN-001: Updates only an existing session and deep-copies supplied context, protecting the manager's owned mutable state.

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_context
notes: FUN-001: Returns a deep copy of an existing session context or the documented empty context for a missing session.

definitions.name: SessionManager.delete_session
notes: RES-001: This explicit deletion path removes persisted history first and then owned cache/queue state; it remains distinct from timeout eviction.

definitions.name: SessionManager.list_sessions
notes: FUN-001: Keeps the persistent listing authoritative when configured while reusing cached sessions by actual session_id; memory-only listing stays supported.

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_session_count
notes: FUN-001: Counts the configured persistence-backed listing or cache under the lock; it retains the same scope as list_sessions.

definitions.name: SessionManager.cleanup_expired_sessions

definitions.name: SessionManager._cleanup_expired_sessions

definitions.name: SessionManager._run_cleanup

definitions.name: SessionManager.start

definitions.name: SessionManager.stop

definitions.name: SessionManager.create_message_queue

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_message_queue

definitions.name: SessionManager.put_message

definitions.name: SessionManager.get_message

definitions.name: SessionManager._datetime_to_ts
notes: CLS-004: Private static timestamp adapter supports the actual persisted datetime and cached numeric representations, handles optional timestamps explicitly and rejects unrelated values.
